description.value: Q's Restaurant is a Korean and Japanese fusion dining room in Golden, BC, established in 2017 and situated along the Trans-Canada corridor. The menu spans Korean BBQ, sushi rolls, ramen, udon, and Pad Thai, with an emphasis on locally sourced vegetables and seafood and house-made sauces. For touring cyclists riding the Kootenay or Columbia Valley routes, it offers a full sit-down meal with vegetarian and tofu options in a warm indoor setting.
